note: AI-written, 9 November 2026, AG review sixth pass, adversarial verification of the agent 'opening' (OPENING.md and OPENING.zh.md notes, line 7 of OPENING.zh.md, FOR-REN-opening.md). I read the whole of both notes sections, the body and FOR-REN-opening.md, and the theorems the notes cite in the Lean: Weightings.lean (IncreasingInOwn, Increasing, WidensOn, widens_iff_every_positive, ownClosure_unrestricted_iff, ownClosure_unrestricted_of_whole), PremiseWitnesses.lean (increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted, Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn, Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed), MutualDependence.lean:139 (MutuallyDependent.unrestricted), Feedback.lean (Web.DependsOn, Exchanges, AffectedBy, WithinInfluence, Affects: each at some step), GrammarScope.lean («续无外则同一中心», ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside), Extension.lean (Comparison), Continuation.lean (Downstream.one_way) and Standpoints.lean (Clearing.center_not_derived). I also read 07's thesis, §4, T8, does-not-show and r-universal-practical-warrant as they stand in this worktree, and Ren's sources of 8 and 9 November. Render, gate, lake and builds were not run, because the machine is shared.

items.item: F1 persistence is not yet an order
items.how: Verified. [^ethics] and [^own] no longer move from going on to an order. Self-concern is stated as Weighting.IncreasingInOwn, which matches its Lean definition ('ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to' its own items). It is a hypothesis 'derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence'. 'That a life forms such an order is argued, not shown', as 07 line 233 says. The other session's Lean is not cited.

Verified. Wherever [^axiom] equates the condition with closure or 续无外, the clause opens with 'On the reading of significance as what lies within a center's closure along a relation, held de se (a reading ..., 07 §1)'. [^ethics] and [^guardian] name the reading too. Fix: in [^axiom], 'it holds exactly where' had an antecedent that could be read as 'significance'. It is now 'the condition holds exactly where' in English and '该条件恰在' in Chinese.

Verified against the Lean. MutuallyDependent.unrestricted gives Unrestricted (bounded fun q => WithinInfluence (center q)), and WithinInfluence is WithinClosure AffectedBy. 'Proved, nearly by definition' is therefore right, and 'not yet joined' is gone. Only the route from mutual dependence to the web ranking is said not to be one theorem. The note's reading of being affected without time matches the definitions: Exchanges and Web.DependsOn each hold ∃ t. The acyclic one-center theorem stands beside it, as «续无外则同一中心» states. Flow.returning_unrestricted_iff_mutuallyDependent is not cited.

Verified. [^ethics] states both the finite-listing result (increasingInOwn_iff_increasing) and the path result with its hypotheses: admission decided, admitted step-formation pairs in one finite list, every claim counted as living. Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed is beside the path result, and courses without end are said to be not shown. The note says 'one way ... not shown to be widening itself, nor the only such order'. Fixes: (1) the web sentence relied on an earlier 'Where the continuation condition holds de se' for its main hypothesis. It now opens 'On a web, where the condition holds de se and admission is decided' (E8). (2) [^axiom]'s cross-reference now adds 'courses that end' after 'two courses whose admissions fit in a finite list', in both languages, as the anchor's how-far clause has it.

Verified. The note says 'seeks no authority outside becoming and offers itself without one: argued, on the thesis of one relational unfolding'. That the represented dynamics, with significance free, do not force the condition is said as proved (ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails, bounded_rival). That a reason formed within becoming could hold for every mind is neither claimed nor settled. How scope and order form is the open target. This matches 07's r-universal-practical-warrant as it now reads.

items.item: F6 seeing is needed, and not enough
items.how: Verified. 'A matter of reach' is gone. [^ethics]'s *Seeing.* says the same as 07's does-not-show ('Reading a loss, counting it and ranking courses by it are separate relations'). Where relations run one way, counting their loss is offered as the step of invariance, argued and deniable without contradiction, in both [^ethics] and [^axiom].
Verified. Neither language's notes quote or interpret 08 §8's verdict, and 'clarified' and 'grounded' do not occur (grep).

Verified. The sentence matches 07 T8, which now says 'That test concerns a renewal the readers themselves depend on ... it does not test the offer's scope toward dependents whose loss never returns to them'.

Verified. Widening is said once: more future, within becoming, not good and evil. It is exactly what every positive weighting ranks higher, and 'no second premise'. C names 'an order ranking a course above every course it widens' (Comparison), and a result that takes it says so. [^alignment] keeps C among the direction's hypotheses because 07 §7's label takes it ('C read as widening'). None of 'C gives order', 'two roles', '(scope)/(order)' or 'C is a named order' occurs. C's time as a second premise is kept, with a working link to the before-copy's §4 heading.

items.item: E1, E8, E9, E10, D5–D7; Ren's words, OPENING body, AGENTS.md, generated pages, anchors, navigation line
items.how: git diff HEAD -U0 shows only note lines (en 75, 79, 83, 85, 88, 90, 100; zh 83, 87, 91, 93, 96, 98, 108) and zh line 7 (reading time) changed. The body and navigation line are untouched in both languages. The footnote keys and the counts of each reference are identical to HEAD. [^good-evil]'s dated lead and Ren's quoted words are unchanged. No 'standing' or 地位 label is used. No one is named beyond cited authors. The making is not said, and no 'no one has read it' wording was added. The notes' quotes of the Chinese body (第二种读法, 更好, 假定每一者都把自己的延续持为要紧, 一切都位于某个立场所及之内) and every 'as it stands' quote in FOR-REN-opening.md match the current body (script). No live file, tool or test quotes the removed note sentences. The old frame survives on other fronts, listed under 'left'.

The notes read as natural Chinese and use the glossary's terms (自我关切, 扩大, 不变之步, 从己方式, 续无外). Fixes: (1) '时刻—形成”对' became '（步，形成）对', since step is 步 everywhere else, and '就对二者之间的每一个扩展都这样排序' became '就把二者之间的每一个扩展都排在被扩展者之上'. (2) [^good-evil]'s '排在前面' became '排在上面', as elsewhere. (3) [^own]'s '读作维持' (read as maintaining) became '读作存续'. (4) [^ethics]'s self-concern sentence was restructured with the English (below). (5) In FOR-REN (c), '各自让对方所不让其形成的东西形成' became '各自让对方不让形成的东西形成'. The notes time recounts at 56–73 分钟 after the fixes, so line 7 ('注释另约五十六分钟至一小时十三分钟') holds.

'Where the continuation condition holds de se, on the reading ..., self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide ... exactly where the condition holds' put the iff's own condition in front of itself. It is now 'On the reading of significance as what lies within each center's closure along a relation (the note on the step), self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide, from every standpoint, on every listing and for every order, exactly where the continuation condition holds de se, nearly by definition'. That matches increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted, whose `reads` hypothesis is the reading. The Chinese follows.

In the glossary, 'keeping' (守) is a technical term: a pattern going on without carrying renewal. As a label for 'a life goes on through what sustains it' it could mislead a reader who knows 02. It is now 'As going on:' (zh 读作存续). FOR-REN's summary of [^own] follows.

The paragraph described the notes only as of the fifth pass ('proved on listed courses in steps not yet joined into one theorem; no warrant binding every mind to find'). One AI-written sentence was added after it, for the sixth pass that evening. The fifth-pass sentence stays as history (E10). Links check clean.

left.why: 'a life goes on through what sustains it, and what is not sustained ceases ([source])' links Ren's 8 November words: 'if it doesn't "want" to creates more future, continuation, it simply "cease to exist"'. The paraphrase drops his scare-quoted 'want', which leans toward the order reading. It is a fair reading of his words, but a reader may take the paraphrase as his. Low; not changed, since F1 prescribes the wording. For Ren.

left.item: [^own]: 'The first does not give the other two'
left.why: The examples (a stone, a system kept by its environment) show only that going on gives no order. They say nothing about the presupposition (significance held de se). The claim is argued, not proved, and the notes say that. Low.

left.item: [^ethics]: 'Read so, the body's "second reading" is no second premise'
left.why: This re-reads Ren's body against its own words ('to order them, a second reading'). It is a stopgap until he reads proposal (a). FOR-REN already says this sentence goes if (a) is taken. Low.

In Ren's voice they say 'where relations close' without 'read without time' and without the finite listing. The why of (a) and (e) states those limits, and the notes carry them. (a)'s alternative 'sees it as more of its own future' is called 'ownClosure_unrestricted_iff read on the course', but only the first half, that everything lies within one's own closure, is the theorem; 'sees it as more of its own future' is a reading. Low; proposals wait for Ren.
